subject.description: The name of the subject being taught.

class.description: The name of the class or course.

term.description: The term number (could be a string or integer, depending on the context).

weeks.description: A list of weeks in the course, each with details about topics, subtopics, and assignments.

week_number.description: The number of the week (e.g., Week 1, Week 2, etc.).

week_topic.description: The main topic covered during the week.

week_subtopics.description: A list of subtopics related to the week's topic.

items.description: A subtopic under the week's main topic.

introduction.description: An introductory paragraph or overview for the week, explaining what students will learn.

subtopics.description: A list of subtopics within the week, each with detailed content and resources.

subtopic.description: The title or name of the subtopic.

content.description: The detailed content or explanation for the subtopic.

introduction.description: An introductory paragraph or overview for the subtopic.

figures.description: A list of paths or URLs to images related to the subtopic.

items.description: The file path or URL of an image associated with the subtopic.

tables.description: A list of paths or URLs to tables related to the subtopic.

items.description: The file path or URL of a table related to the subtopic.

formular.description: A list of formulas related to the subtopic.

items.description: The formula or equation related to the subtopic.

assignments.description: A list of assignments for the week, each with questions and the type of question.

question.description: The question or task to be completed in the assignment.

options.description: A list of options for objective questions.

items.description: An option for an objective question.

conditional.description: This field is required only if the question type is 'objective'.
